name: RiteBite Max Protein 7 Grain Breakfast Cookie Nuts & Seeds
ingredients_raw: Protein Blend (22%) (High Protein Peanut Flour, Whey Protein Concentrate, Wheat Protein, Soy Protein Isolate), Nuts & Seeds Blend (17%) (Butterscotch Pieces, Watermelon Seeds, Pumpkin Seeds, Almond, Flaxseeds), Edible Vegetable Fat (Bakery Shortening), Invert Syrup, Millets & Pulses Blend (Wheat Flour, Oats Flour, Quinoa Flour, Bengal Gram Flour, Ragi Flour, Corn Flour, Amaranth Puff), Dietary Fiber (Fructooligosaccharide), Sugar, Condensed Milk, Humectant (Glycerine), Tribasic Calcium Phosphate, Leavening Agent (Baking Soda), Binding Agent (Gum Acacia, Xanthan Gum), Emulsifier (INS471, INS472e, INS322(i) - Soy Lecithin), Salt, Cinnamon Powder, Antioxidant (Rosemary Extract).
